trigger: Player attack hits enemy or enemy attack hits player
recipe: 5-8 white/yellow circles, radius 2-4px, expand to 10px, fade out over 0.2s, random velocity
White crescent shape, rotates with attack direction, fades out over 0.15s, scale 1.0 to 1.2

trigger: Damage dealt to enemy or player
recipe: White text (crit: yellow), 12px, floats up 30px, fades out over 0.8s, slight random horizontal offset
10-15 gray smoke particles, radius 3-6px, expand and fade over 0.5s, upward drift
Red semi-transparent circle, radius 50-100px, pulses opacity 0.3-0.7, duration 0.5-1.5s
Red semi-transparent line, width 4px, length 200-400px, pulses opacity 0.3-0.7, duration 0.5-1.5s
3-5 small circles, color matches projectile, fade out over 0.3s, follow projectile path

trigger: Exploder enemy death or boss slam
recipe: Orange/yellow ring, expands from 0 to 100px, fades out over 0.4s, thickness 5px
Green particles, radius 2-3px, rise from player, fade out over 0.6s, count 8-12
Blue semi-transparent circle around player, radius 30px, pulses opacity 0.2-0.4, duration matches shield
Orange/red particles, radius 2-4px, rise from enemy, fade out over 0.4s, count 3-5 per second
Yellow stars, radius 3px, orbit around enemy head, duration 1s, count 3
White/gray streaks, length 20px, fade out over 0.2s, follow movement direction, count 5-8
White screen flash, opacity 0.8 to 0, duration 0.3s, followed by gold particles rising from exit door
